scripts.build:apk: npx cap sync android && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='android/app/src/main/assets/public/index.html';const id=process.env.GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID||'';if(!id){console.error('Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID env var to enable Google Sign-In');}else{fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('__GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID__',id));console.log('Injected Google Client ID');}" && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
